name: Metrix Analytics
author: Metrix Analytics

sections.description:
Metrix Analytics is a privacy-focused web analytics solution that provides real-time visitor insights while respecting user privacy and maintaining GDPR compliance. This plugin seamlessly integrates your WordPress site with Metrix Analytics tracking.

Key Features:
* Privacy-focused analytics
* GDPR compliant
* Real-time visitor insights
* Easy WordPress integration
* Lightweight and fast
* No impact on site performance

Why Choose Metrix Analytics?
* Respect user privacy with cookieless tracking
* Get actionable insights without compromising visitor privacy
* Simple setup and configuration
* Swedish-developed with EU privacy standards in mind

External services

This plugin connects to the Metrix Analytics service to provide web analytics functionality for your WordPress site.

Service: Metrix Analytics tracking service
Purpose: To collect and analyze website visitor data for analytics insights
Domain: https://track.metrix.se

What data is sent:
The plugin loads a tracking script from https://track.metrix.se/metrix.js and sends the following visitor data:
* Page views and URL information
* Referrer information
* Browser and device information
* User interaction data (clicks, scrolls, time on page)
* IP address (processed in a privacy-compliant manner)

When data is sent:
Data is transmitted when visitors access pages on your website where the tracking script is active. The plugin only sends data when a valid tracking ID is configured in the plugin settings.

Privacy and compliance:
Metrix Analytics is designed to be GDPR compliant and uses cookieless tracking to respect user privacy.

Service provider: Metrix Analytics
Terms of Service: https://www.metrix.se/villkor/
Privacy Policy: https://www.metrix.se/integritetspolicy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/metrix-analytics directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Settings -> Metrix Analytics screen to configure the plugin.
  4. Sign up for a free Metrix Analytics account at https://dashboard.metrix.se
  5. Add your domain and copy the tracking ID to the plugin settings.
sections.faq:
Is Metrix Analytics GDPR compliant?

Yes, Metrix Analytics is designed with privacy in mind and is fully GDPR compliant. It uses cookieless tracking and respects visitor privacy.

Do I need to add a cookie banner?

No, Metrix Analytics uses cookieless tracking, so you don’t need to display cookie banners for analytics purposes.

How do I get my tracking ID?

  1. Sign up for a free account at https://dashboard.metrix.se
  2. Add your website domain in the dashboard
  3. Copy the tracking ID from the Configuration tab
  4. Paste it into the plugin settings

Will this slow down my website?

No, Metrix Analytics is designed to be lightweight and loads asynchronously without affecting your website’s performance.
